visual_text: Does food still smell of anything?
About 6 in 10 people aged 80 and over had a weakened sense of smell when tested. Most did not know.
Try: stronger flavours, a sauce, herbs, a squeeze of lemon
Herbs, sauces and lemon are untested. Two trials of commercial flavour enhancers gave mixed results
Ask your GP or pharmacist if a medicine started recently could change taste
Do not stop a medicine on your own
Murphy et al., JAMA 2002 (2,491 people, one US town)
alt_text: Drawing of a plate of poached fish, potatoes and green beans with steam, with a pepper mill, sauce jug, lemon wedge and herbs, each labelled. About 6 in 10 people aged 80 and over had a weakened sense of smell on testing. Tips: stronger flavours; these are untested. Ask a GP or pharmacist about medicines; do not stop one yourself.
